judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format this dataset; it does not describe the frequency-tagging dataset itself.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: MEG-BIDS is the BIDS extension specification for MEG data, which this dataset follows for its organization. It does not describe this frequency-tagging dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
